reviews.reviewText: We arranged a 3-day spiritual tour for our family to Mathura and Vrindavan. TirthYatraTrails ensured our hotel was barely 5 minutes from Banke Bihari and Prem Mandir. The morning temple transfer, clean Sattvic dining, and dedicated tour manager made our darshan utterly blissful without any stress.

We arranged a 6-day pilgrimage for our elderly parents to Kashi Vishwanath and Ayodhya Ram Mandir. TirthYatraTrails managed everything with utmost devotion — wheelchair assistance was waiting right at the ghats, our hotel was 4 minutes from the sanctum gate, and the kitchen prepared pure Jain-Sattvic meals daily. Having a dedicated 24x7 travel desk gave our entire family complete peace of mind.

Booking the Special Entry Darshan pass and hillside accommodation through TirthYatraTrails was seamless. From Chennai airport cab pickup to the Tirumala hilltop cottage, everything was timely and respectful of traditional rituals. Truly exceptional service.
